Owned constructor writes the untrusted msg.sender into the privileged owner state variable.
transferOwnership stages the caller-supplied address in newOwner, the first step of the ownership handover.
acceptOwnership overwrites the privileged owner variable after checking msg.sender == newOwner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0) at the end of the handover.
Leaf constructor assigns the constant token symbol.
Leaf constructor assigns the constant token name.
Leaf constructor assigns the decimals value.
Leaf constructor mints and stores the entire token supply in _totalSupply.
Leaf constructor credits the whole supply to a hard-coded address in the balances mapping.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer debits and credits the balances mapping.
approve writes the allowed mapping for msg.sender and spender.
transferFrom debits the from balance and credits the to balance in the balances mapping.
transferFrom decreases the caller's allowance inside the allowed mapping.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowance for msg.sender and the spender before making the external call.
safeAdd body performs the uint addition and overflow require represented by the arithmetic operation.
safeSub body performs the uint subtraction represented by the arithmetic operation.
safeMul body performs the uint multiplication represented by the arithmetic operation.
safeDiv body performs the uint division represented by the arithmetic operation.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub twice to debit the from balance and the caller allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
The Owned constructor derives ownership directly from the untrusted msg.sender.
transfer uses msg.sender to select which balance is debited.
approve grants allowances under the identity of the untrusted msg.sender.
transferFrom checks and debits the allowance keyed by the untrusted msg.sender.
approveAndCall writes the allowance for the untrusted msg.sender and forwards it to the callee.
The onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal the staged newOwner.
The onlyOwner modifier gates transferAnyERC20Token on msg.sender == owner.
approveAndCall executes the external receiveApproval call after updating the allowance.
transferAnyERC20Token executes an external ERC20 transfer on a caller-supplied contract.
The attacker-controlled spender address becomes the target contract of the reentrancy-prone external call.
The caller-supplied tokenAddress becomes the external contract executed by transferAnyERC20Token.
The untrusted callee of receiveApproval can re-enter approveAndCall during the external call.
A malicious callee can re-enter the contract and further manipulate the allowed allowance mapping.
A malicious token contract can re-enter transferAnyERC20Token while the external call is in flight.
